lines: From thigh to big toe fire of time she should throw; in coming and going movement should move she, marked with liṅga.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ūrvādyaṅguṣṭhakālāgniparyante sā vinikṣipet gamāgamanasañcāre caretsā liṅgaliṅginī
